svg.text: Upload a changed file (orange) and sync it to the user's other devices (indigo)

g.text: Laptop tells the API: new version; status = pending
File is split into blocks; only changed blocks are uploaded (delta sync)
Blocks are compressed, encrypted and stored in S3
Notification service wakes the phone's long-poll connection
Phone fetches the new metadata and downloads changed blocks
Offline devices get the change from a queue when they reconnect
Rarely used old versions move to cheaper cold storage
